messages.content: Time complexity of main algo of sorting and other imp algo i discussed

Alright, here’s a **clear, complete summary of the time complexities** for all the **main sorting algorithms** and **other key algorithms** (the ones you’ve discussed recently like Graphs, Trees, Searching, etc.).  

---

## ⚙️ **SORTING ALGORITHMS**

| Algorithm | Best Case | Average Case | Worst Case | Space Complexity | Notes |
|------------|------------|---------------|--------------|------------------|--------|
| **Bubble Sort** | O(n) | O(n²) | O(n²) | O(1) | Best when array is nearly sorted |
| **Selection Sort** | O(n²) | O(n²) | O(n²) | O(1) | Always takes same time; not adaptive |
| **Insertion Sort** | O(n) | O(n²) | O(n²) | O(1) | Good for small or nearly sorted data |
| **Merge Sort** | O(n log n) | O(n log n) | O(n log n) | O(n) | Divide & Conquer; stable |
| **Quick Sort** | O(n log n) | O(n log n) | O(n²) | O(log n) | Fastest in practice; worst when pivot bad |
| **Heap Sort** | O(n log n) | O(n log n) | O(n log n) | O(1) | Based on heap data structure |
| **Counting Sort** | O(n + k) | O(n + k) | O(n + k) | O(k) | Works only for integers in small range |
| **Radix Sort** | O(nk) | O(nk) | O(nk) | O(n + k) | Non-comparative; works digit by digit |
| **Bucket Sort** | O(n + k) | O(n + k) | O(n²) | O(n) | Works well for uniformly distributed data |

---

## 🔍 **SEARCHING ALGORITHMS**

| Algorithm | Best Case | Average Case | Worst Case | Notes |
|------------|------------|---------------|--------------|--------|
| **Linear Search** | O(1) | O(n) | O(n) | Simple, works on unsorted data |
| **Binary Search** | O(1) | O(log n) | O(log n) | Needs sorted data |
| **Hash Search (Hash Table)** | O(1) | O(1) | O(n) | Depends on hash collisions |

---

## 🌳 **TREE ALGORITHMS**

| Algorithm / Operation | Time Complexity | Notes |
|------------------------|------------------|--------|
| **Binary Search Tree (BST) Search/Insert/Delete** | O(h), where h = height | O(log n) if balanced, O(n) if skewed |
| **AVL Tree Search/Insert/Delete** | O(log n) | Always balanced |
| **Tree Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder)** | O(n) | Visit every node once |

---

## 🧠 **GRAPH ALGORITHMS**

| Algorithm | Time Complexity | Notes |
|------------|------------------|--------|
| **BFS (Breadth-First Search)** | O(V + E) | V = vertices, E = edges |
| **DFS (Depth-First Search)** | O(V + E) | Recursive or stack-based |
| **Dijkstra’s Algorithm** | O(V²) or O(E log V) with min-heap | Finds shortest path |
| **Prim’s Algorithm** | O(V²) or O(E log V) | Finds Minimum Spanning Tree |
| **Kruskal’s Algorithm** | O(E log E) | Uses sorting + Union-Find |
| **Topological Sort** | O(V + E) | Works on DAGs only |
| **Floyd-Warshall** | O(V³) | All-pairs shortest path |
| **Bellman-Ford** | O(V × E) | Handles negative weights |

---

## 🧮 **OTHER IMPORTANT ONES**

| Algorithm / Concept | Time Complexity | Notes |
|----------------------|------------------|--------|
| **Fibonacci (Recursive)** | O(2ⁿ) | Very slow |
| **Fibonacci (Dynamic / Iterative)** | O(n) | Efficient |
| **Factorial (Recursive)** | O(n) | Calls function n times |
| **Reverse an Integer / Array** | O(n) | One pass |
| **Stack / Queue Operations** | O(1) | Push, Pop, Enqueue, Dequeue |
| **HashMap Insert/Search/Delete** | O(1) average | Depends on collisions |
| **Linked List Traversal** | O(n) | Visits all nodes |
| **Matrix Multiplication (Naive)** | O(n³) | Can be improved by Strassen’s O(n^2.81) |

---
